response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and some low-latency, high-throughput systems work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O, fibers and caching — which maps conceptually onto the performance mindset this role needs. However, the core requirement is modern C++ (or Rust) systems development, and his only C/C++ exposure is a six-month stint at National Instruments over a decade ago plus a university thesis; his recent decade is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js/D full-stack and product work. There is also no evidence of routing/navigation tile pipelines, distributed-systems fault tolerance/consistency work, or large-scale data pipeline operations. He could be a fit if the team values geospatial domain knowledge and is willing to accept a language ramp-up, hence a cautious maybe rather than a clear yes.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain experience (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk)
Low-latency, high-throughput microservices work at Sociomantic (async I/O, caching, fibers)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, Linux and Docker infrastructure
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience effectively absent; C/C++ only ~10 years ago
No routing tile pipeline or navigation-guidance systems experience
Recent roles are web/full-stack product-focused rather than systems/data-pipeline engineering
